meta.name: ASTRO GOT TALENT 2026 Design System

stack.componentStyle: shadcn radix-nova, rsc:false, radix-ui unified package

constraints: Tailwind v4 emits a utility ONLY for a declared @theme token. bg-pastel-orange, text-pastel-orange etc. do not exist until --color-pastel-orange is added to @theme inline.
next.config.ts CSP sets font-src 'self' data: — no external font CDN. next/font self-hosts, so Google Fonts is fine.
next.config.ts CSP sets img-src without i.ibb.co.com; the OG image URL in app/layout.tsx cannot render in-page.
Brand hex is inlined in ~100 JSX sites and in the cva base of components/ui/button.tsx — token edits alone will not restyle the UI.

migrationStrategy.rationale: The legacy utility class names (.astro-card, .astro-title-chrome, .astro-frame-y, .clip-angled*) are applied at ~130 sites across app/ and components/. Rather than edit every call site up front, each legacy class is REDEFINED in app/globals.css to the new artwork recipe, and the new semantic name is added as an alias. Every existing call site therefore adopts the new look with zero file edits, and the rename becomes an optional cleanup rather than a prerequisite.

borderRadius.conflictResolution: Tailwind v4 default is rounded-lg=8px / rounded-md=6px, and this project's --radius:1rem derivation gave lg=16px / md=12.8px. --radius-lg and --radius-md are now overridden in @theme inline to 12px/8px so the class names and these token values agree. The full sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/3xl/4xl ramp is restated as literal px rather than calc() multiples of --radius.
borderRadius.normalizeFrom: Four coexisting channels: token classes, hardcoded px (rounded-[16px] x9, rounded-[14px] x9, rounded-[22px], rounded-[12px]), min()/calc() clamps, and the vestigial .clip-angled/-sm/-lg classes. Plus ~40 inline clipPath:polygon() styles and ~80 clip-angled* applications in app/dashboard/**. .clip-angled* is redefined onto the new ramp (lg/md/xl) so the dashboard normalizes without edits; the inline polygons still need a manual sweep.

gloss.role: Top specular highlight; pair with every gradient button

shadows.conflictResolution: The spec's soft-diffuse shadow-sm/md/lg slots are NOT globally overridden. Overriding Tailwind's --shadow-sm/md/lg would give every dropdown, popover, tooltip and dialog a hard navy offset, which reads as broken chrome on floating overlays. Instead the sticker shadows are named tokens and brand components opt in via shadow-sticker*. Where this JSON's component definitions say shadow-md / shadow-lg / shadow-sm, author shadow-sticker / shadow-sticker-lg / shadow-sticker-sm.

display.role: Hero wordmarks, section H2, chrome headlines

alt.source: Space Grotesk → Plus Jakarta Sans → system

fixes: --font-space-grotesk is now declared in @theme inline, so the font-space-grotesk utility used at app/profile/journey/[id]/page.tsx:148,156,163 resolves instead of silently falling back to Geist.
text-astro-600 at app/profile/journey/[id]/page.tsx:351 is still not a declared color and emits nothing — fix at the call site.
Plus Jakarta Sans is downloaded and applied to <html> but only ever appears as a fallback behind Space Grotesk inside --font-display — a wasted font download.

motion.float: animate={{ y:[0,-20,0] }} transition={{ duration:7, repeat:Infinity, ease:'easeInOut' }}
motion.reducedMotion: useReducedMotion() guard is REQUIRED. The global @media (prefers-reduced-motion) rule in globals.css catches CSS animations only, not Motion's JS-driven values.

astro-chrome.recipe: white -webkit-text-stroke + background-clip:text vertical white→cyan-2→blue gradient + 3-layer hard text-shadow (0 2px 0 #fff, 0 5px 0 var(--color-astro-cyan-2), 0 9px 0 var(--color-astro-navy))

astro-sticker.recipe: background:#fff; border:3px solid var(--color-astro-navy); border-radius:var(--radius-lg); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sticker) + var(--shadow-gloss); NO backdrop-filter

astro-chevron-y.recipe: blue ground band on section top+bottom edges with a lime triangle zigzag (two 135deg/225deg linear-gradients at 22px tiles) and a gold inner keyline

astro-sky-soft.retuned: pale variant of the same ramp

astro-bubble-field.retuned: translucent circles with a top-left specular highlight dot, per the artwork

astro-pill.retuned: backdrop-filter dropped; solid white fill + 3px astro-navy border + sticker-sm shadow

astro-panel.retuned: inverted blue gradient panel, 3px white border, sticker-lg offset. Retained rather than deleted because app/dashboard/page.tsx applies it.

clip-angled.note: ~80 dashboard call sites normalize onto the new ramp without edits
